list_content.title: Query content entries
list_content.description: Query a model's content entries with the Content API v3: MongoDB-style filters, targeting attributes, field selection, sorting and limit/offset paging. Returns {results: [...]} (plus totalCount when asked). Use get_content_entry when you already know the id, or get_html to get rendered HTML.

model.description: The model's unique name, e.g. page, symbol, blog-article.

offset.description: Entries to skip, for pagination with limit (default 0).

fetch_total_count.description: Add totalCount (all matching entries) to the response, for pagination.

sort_name.description: Sort by entry name: 1 ascending, -1 descending.

no_targeting.description: Return entries regardless of their targeting (build-time listing). Without targeting attributes only matching/untargeted entries come back.

exclude_expired.description: Leave out entries whose scheduled end date has passed.

exclude_scheduled.description: Leave out entries whose scheduled start date hasn't arrived yet.

query.description: MongoDB-style filter as a JSON object string over any entry field (id, name, data.*, meta.*, published, lastUpdated...), e.g. {"data.slug": "my-post"} or {"data.price": {"$lt": 100}}. Operators: $eq $ne $gt $gte $lt $lte $in $nin $and $or $nor $not $exists $type $elemMatch $regex $options. Wrap number-like text values in single quotes, e.g. "'12345'".

user_attributes.description: Targeting attributes as a JSON object string, e.g. {"urlPath": "/about", "device": "desktop", "locale": "en-US"}, plus any custom attribute; optional `date` overrides server time for scheduling. urlPath and locale are indexed and fastest. Content with targeting is only returned when matching attributes are sent.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. id,name,data.customField.

omit.description: Comma-separated fields to leave out, e.g. data.bigField,data.blocks; applied after `fields`.

locale.description: Locale to resolve localized field values for, e.g. en-US.

include_unpublished.description: Include draft/unpublished entries (useful for previews and testing).

enrich.description: Resolve references and Symbols inline so the response matches what the Visual Editor shows.

enrich_options.description: With enrich=true, a JSON object string choosing fields per referenced model and depth, e.g. {"model": {"author": {"fields": "id,name,data", "omit": "data.blocks"}}, "enrichLevel": 2}; enrichLevel is 1-4.

include_refs.description: Include the content of referenced entries in the response.

no_traverse.description: When false, Symbol JSON is included in the response so a page can render in one pass (server-side rendering).

omit_hidden_layers.description: Exclude layers hidden in the Visual Editor from the response.

cachebust.description: Bypass the CDN cache for the freshest data. Much slower: build time or debugging only, never at runtime.

cache_seconds.description: Seconds to cache the response (sets cache-control max-age). Higher is faster, lower suits frequently changing content.

stale_cache_seconds.description: Seconds stale content may be served while revalidating in the background; minimum 3600.

results.description: Content entries: id, name, data, published, modelId, lastUpdated, ...

totalCount.description: Total matches, when fetch_total_count is set.

get_content_entry.title: Get content entry

get_html.title: Get rendered HTML
get_html.description: Server-side render the best-matching entry of a model with the HTML API v3 and return it with data.html, ready to inline into any site. Target with url or url_path. Custom code components are not rendered by this API. Use list_content for raw JSON.

model.description: The model's unique name, e.g. page, symbol, blog-article.

url.description: The visitor's current URL, used to match targeting, e.g. https://your-site.com/about?foo=bar.

url_path.description: Target by URL path only, e.g. /about (sent as userAttributes.urlPath).

query.description: MongoDB-style filter as a JSON object string over any entry field (id, name, data.*, meta.*, published, lastUpdated...), e.g. {"data.slug": "my-post"} or {"data.price": {"$lt": 100}}. output.description: The matching entry with pre-rendered HTML in data.html.

get_qwik_html.title: Get Qwik-rendered HTML
get_qwik_html.description: Pre-render the best-matching entry with the Qwik API (beta): optimized HTML in data.html that needs only qwikloader.js to become interactive. Fewer features than get_html; target with url or url_path.

graphql_query.title: Run GraphQL content query
graphql_query.description: Query published content through the GraphQL Content API v3 (https://cdn.builder.io/api/v3/graphql/{apiKey}). Each model is a root field `model(...)` for lists and `oneModel(...)` for one entry, taking limit, offset, query, target, sort, prerender, e.g. { page(target: {urlPath: "/"}, limit: 1) { id name data { title } } }. Returns {data, errors}.

query.description: The GraphQL document, e.g. query { page(limit: 10) { id name data { url } } }.
